notes: Synthetic fixture testing localized hybrid detection with a circular stamp seal in the bottom right corner. This tests whether the classifier can detect hybrid content when it's concentrated in a small region rather than distributed across the page. The circular stamp crosses grid cell boundaries radially, creating complex hybrid cell patterns that test the 8×8 grid evaluation approach. The red color on grayscale background also tests color-aware classification if implemented. This fixture represents a common real-world pattern: approval stamps, notary seals, and validation marks on otherwise scanned documents.
